basic_profile.bio: An avid fan of fantasy literature, particularly the Dresden Files series. Despite being lactose intolerant, they enjoy exploring new culinary experiences, often leading to humorous mishaps. A native of Cleveland, Ohio, they spend weekends by Lake Erie, weather permitting. Works as a software developer, which allows for a flexible schedule that aligns with their nocturnal online habits. Single but enjoys the company of a tight-knit group of friends who share similar bookish interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in programming and software development, mainly through online courses and practical projects. Extensive knowledge of the Dresden Files series, having read the books multiple times and participated in fan discussions.
